[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] '''Dulrain''' was the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Munifex-class light cruiser|''Munifex''-class light cruiser]] [[Intrepid (Munifex-class)|''Intrepid'']]. He was considered a difficult man to con.<ref name="GG6">''[[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters]]''</ref>
